> Do you gno?

This repository is a hub for apps, frameworks, libraries, and resources.

## Contents

1. [Apps](#apps)
2. [Archive](#archive)

## Apps

_Apps developed by the gno.land team._

- [Gno Playground](https://play.gno.land/) - An online Gno editor.
- [r/docs](https://staging.gno.land/r/docs/home) - The on-chain documentation realm.
- [Gno Debugger](https://gno.land/r/gnoland/blog:p/gno-debugger) - A debugger packaged with the GnoVM.
- [Kourt](https://kourt.xyz) - Fact-staking courts. [Source](https://github.com/jaekwon/kourt), [realm](https://gno.land/r/g1ecsuj0q572jr0dhu29q9njtnmw03hyu7tyyvv6/kourt).
- [legacy Bounties (deprecated)](https://github.com/gnolang/bounties) - Legacy official bounty board.
- [Discord](https://discord.com/invite/gnoland)

## Archive

_Older, outdated, or archived items._

- The Portal Loop - The rolling testnet that used to serve the gno.land homepage.
- [tx-exports](https://github.com/gnolang/tx-exports) - Archived transaction data, `one directory` per network.

## Contributing

Your contributions are always welcome! Please take a look at the
[contribution guidelines](https://github.com/gnoverse/awesome-gno/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) first.
